Type: chair
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Alonzo Contemporary Upholstered Livingroom Accent Chair, 39"W, Light Grey
Colors: Light Grey
Materials: Wood
Sleek, graceful lines combine with modern touches for a vesatile, elegant armchair. A solid-wood frame and strong brass legs offer durability and comfort that will stand the test of time. Overall: 39"W x 37.8"D x 35.4"H. Seat Height: 18.11"H; Seat Depth: 22"D; Seat Back Height: 17.3"H; Arm Height: 23.6"H; Leg Height: 7.1"H Solid-wood frame with brass metal legs and fabric upholstery Reversible seat and back cushions Simple assembly in less than 15 minutes Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
